About Surana Real Estates

Our Story

Shaping Pune's skyline with trust and architectural distinction

Surana Real Estates was founded on a simple premise: real estate development should be rooted in absolute transparency, structural integrity, and enduring value. We set out to build a firm where clients receive honest guidance and strategic insights rather than sales pitches.

Over the decades, our dedicated team has helped hundreds of families and businesses find their place across Pune's high-growth corridors like Wakad, Bibwewadi, and Lullanagar. We remain proudly rooted in Pune, focused on delivering thoughtful spaces.

Today, Surana Real Estates is known for prime residential communities, thriving commercial hubs, and an advisory approach that stays focused on your goals long after you get the keys.
